s.t:
Was du wissen solltest
Die meisten Stellenanzeigen klingen gleich. Unsere nicht – weil der Job nicht gleich ist.
Wir suchen keine Person, die „digitales Marketing kann“. Davon gibt es viele. Wir suchen jemanden, der verstanden hat, warum 80 % des Marketings da draußen nicht funktioniert – und den Ehrgeiz hat, es besser zu machen. Mit Substanz statt Worthülsen. Mit messbarer Wirkung statt hübscher Dashboards.
Clue One verbindet Beratung, Umsetzung und Technologie – für Kunden wie AOK, UNICEF, Orlen oder die Sparkasse. Seit 2022 sind wir als Top Consultant ausgezeichnet. Nicht weil wir gut präsentieren, sondern weil wir liefern.
Wofür wir stehen
Marketing hat ein Glaubwürdigkeitsproblem. Zu viele Kampagnen verbrennen Budget ohne nachweisbare Wirkung. Zu viele Berater verkaufen Frameworks statt Ergebnisse. Zu viele Teams optimieren Metriken, die fürs Geschäft irrelevant sind.
Wir glauben: Marketing kann wieder ein richtig guter Job sein. Wenn man versteht, was man tut. Wenn man den gesamten Funnel denkt, nicht nur den eigenen Kanal. Und wenn man Technologie nutzt, um klarer und schneller zu arbeiten.
Das ist unsere Mission. Wenn dich das nicht anspricht, ist das völlig okay. Dann ist diese Stelle nicht für dich.
Aufgaben
Was du bei uns machst
Kein Tag sieht gleich aus. Aber die folgenden Dinge wirst du regelmäßig tun:
Kunden eigenverantwortlich betreuen. Du bist erste Ansprechperson für deine Accounts. Du verstehst ihre Ziele, koordinierst ihre Anliegen und sorgst dafür, dass geliefert wird – nicht nur, dass alle freundlich bleiben.
Projekte selbst steuern. Account Management ist bei uns auch Projektmanagement. Du planst, koordinierst und treibst Projekte hands-on – Timing, Budget, Qualität. Du reichst nicht nur weiter, du sorgst dafür, dass es läuft.
Marketing mitdenken. Du redest nicht nur über Marketing, du verstehst die Grundlagen. Du kannst eine Kampagne einordnen und mit unseren Spezialist:innen sinnvoll zusammenarbeiten.
Mit Zahlen arbeiten. Du behältst Budgets, Timings und Ergebnisse im Blick. Du weißt, ob ein Projekt läuft – und woran du das misst. Bauchgefühl reicht uns nicht.
Mit KI schneller werden. KI ist bei uns Arbeitsrealität. Du nutzt sie für Reporting, Recherche und Organisation – und lernst, wo sie hilft und wo nicht. KI als Werkzeug, nicht als Ersatz fürs Denken.
Als Schnittstelle funktionieren. Du übersetzt zwischen Kunde und Spezialist:innen: klare Briefings rein, gute Ergebnisse raus. Du bist der rote Faden im Projekt.
Qualifikation
Wen wir suchen
Mindestens 3 Jahre relevante Erfahrung setzen wir voraus. Aber wichtiger als die Zahl auf dem Papier ist, was du in dieser Zeit wirklich gelernt hast:
Du hast Kunden oder Projekte schon eigenverantwortlich betreut – nicht nur zugearbeitet.
Du bringst Erfahrung im digitalen Marketing mit. Du weißt in Grundzügen, wie Kampagnen und Kanäle funktionieren.
Du arbeitest hands-on und organisiert. Du behältst mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig im Griff, ohne den Überblick zu verlieren.
Du denkst mit, statt nur abzuarbeiten. Wenn etwas in die falsche Richtung läuft, sagst du es – statt es durchzuwinken.
Du gehst KI und neue Tools offen an – weil du schneller und besser werden willst.
Du kommunizierst klar und verbindlich – mit Kunden und Kolleg:innen, auf Deutsch und Englisch.
Wen wir nicht suchen
Genauso wichtig wie das, was wir suchen, ist das, was wir nicht suchen – nicht um dich abzuschrecken, sondern damit wir beide ehrlich sind. Wenn du dich hier wiedererkennst, sind wir wahrscheinlich nicht das richtige Match:
Du verwaltest lieber, als zu treiben. Bei uns reicht niemand nur weiter, was von links nach rechts muss.
Du redest über Marketing, verstehst aber die Grundlagen nicht. Ganz ohne Marketing-Bezug wird es bei uns schwer.
Du arbeitest an Beziehungen, aber nicht an Ergebnissen. Wer nicht weiß, ob ein Projekt läuft, kann es nicht steuern.
Du wartest auf Anweisungen, statt selbst zu denken. Wir brauchen Leute, die Verantwortung übernehmen.
Du hast Angst vor KI oder ignorierst das Thema. KI gehört bei uns zum Alltag.

Was wir bieten
Wir versprechen keine Dinge, die jeder verspricht. Was wir wirklich bieten:
Echte Verantwortung ab Tag 1. Du arbeitest direkt mit Kunden, führst dein eigenes Team und berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung. Kein monatelanges Zugucken.
Ein Team, das liefert. Keine Politik, keine Eitelkeiten, kurze Wege. Wenn du eine Idee hast, kannst du sie morgen umsetzen.
Eine Kultur, die man spürt. Wir fördern und fordern – und lachen dabei viel. Wir arbeiten nach „können, wollen, dürfen“, geben Vertrauensvorschuss statt Kontrolle und diskutieren gern. Jede:r hat eine Stimme. Wir sind ein eingeschworenes Team, das sich den Rücken freihält – nah, ehrlich, supportive.
Hybrid mit Homeoffice-Option. Hamburg oder Wiesbaden als Basis – mit flexiblen Homeoffice-Tagen. Gelegentliche Reisen zwischen unseren Standorten und zu Kunden gehören dazu, halten sich aber im Rahmen.
Ambitioniert – und nachhaltig. Wir arbeiten hart. Aber „Push. Recover. Repeat.“ meinen wir ernst: Wir schätzen echte Pausen. Wer smart regeneriert, liefert länger und besser.
Weiterentwicklung, die den Namen verdient. Eigenes Weiterbildungsbudget, interne Academy, Mentor beim Onboarding.
Weitere Benefits: JobRad, Wellpass, Corporate Benefits, flexible Arbeitsmodelle, Teamevents, unbefristeter Vertrag.
So bewirbst du dich
Wir wollen dich kennenlernen – nicht dein Anschreiben. Schick uns:
Deinen Lebenslauf – auf das Wesentliche reduziert. Was hast du gemacht, was hast du bewirkt?
Ein konkretes Beispiel (3–5 Sätze): ein Kunde oder ein Projekt, das du gut gemacht hast – und warum es gewirkt hat.
Deine ehrliche Einschätzung: Was macht für dich guten Account-Job aus – und woran scheitern die meisten? (2–3 Sätze reichen.)
Deine Arbeitszeugnisse bisheriger Arbeitgeber.
Gehaltsvorstellung und frühester Starttermin.
Kein Anschreiben nötig. Wir wollen verstehen, wie du denkst – nicht, wie gut du Bewerbungen formatierst.
Auch wenn du nicht jeden Punkt zu 100 % erfüllst – wenn du bis hierhin gelesen hast und denkst: Das klingt nach mir – dann melde dich. Den Rest finden wir gemeinsam heraus.

About MonetizeMore For more than 16 years, MonetizeMore has helped digital publishers grow advertising revenue, improve traffic quality, and build more sustainable monetization strategies. We work with high-traffic publishers around the world and are supported by a fully remote team of more than 100 people.

Along the way, we have earned Google certifications, industry recognition, and multiple fastest-growing company awards. We are now looking for a Senior Account Executive to help drive our next stage of growth across EMEA and APAC. The Opportunity This role is for someone who knows how to create momentum.

You will open doors with enterprise publishers, lead high-value commercial conversations, and turn complex monetization challenges into clear business opportunities.

The publishers you speak with may be facing declining revenue, invalid traffic, weak advertiser demand, operational complexity, limited performance visibility, or challenges scaling monetization across different markets and platforms.

Your job is to understand what is really holding them back, identify where MonetizeMore can create measurable value, and lead the opportunity through to close. This is a high-autonomy role. You will have ownership over your territory, pipeline, relationships, and commercial outcomes.

We will give you room to operate, but we will also expect strong judgment, disciplined execution, and consistent results. Who You Are You are a natural hunter who enjoys building opportunities rather than waiting for them.

You think commercially, move with urgency, and are comfortable leading conversations with senior decision-makers across different markets and cultures. You know how to simplify complex ideas, build trust quickly, and create a compelling reason for customers to act.

You bring: 7–10 years of experience in sales, business development, partnerships, or another commercial role. Experience from either the sell side or buy side of the digital advertising ecosystem. A track record of building pipeline and progressing complex or enterprise-level deals. Strong ownership, independence, and an entrepreneurial mindset.

The ability to connect data, insights, and customer pain to measurable business outcomes. A disciplined approach to qualification, forecasting, documentation, follow-up, and deal progression. The confidence to challenge assumptions, solve problems, and keep opportunities moving.

Familiarity with eCPM, fill rate, invalid traffic, programmatic advertising, publisher monetization, and related ad-tech concepts is a strong advantage. Experience working with mobile app publishers is highly desired, particularly in areas such as app monetization, mobile gaming, utility apps, mediation, in-app advertising, or programmatic demand.

Existing relationships with web or mobile publishers, advertisers, agencies, app developers, or ad-tech platforms will help you move faster. Experience selling publisher inventory to DV360 advertisers is valuable, but not required. Strong English communication skills are required.

Additional languages relevant to EMEA or APAC markets are a significant advantage. What You Will Own Build and manage a pipeline of enterprise web and mobile app publishers across EMEA and APAC. Create opportunities through outbound outreach, referrals, events, communities, and industry relationships.

Secure conversations with the right decision-makers and turn early interest into qualified opportunities. Lead discovery to uncover commercial, technical, and operational challenges. Build clear business cases around revenue growth, traffic protection, advertiser trust, and operational improvement.

Manage the full sales cycle from first contact through negotiation, contracting, and close. Maintain accurate forecasts, next steps, risks, and opportunity data in Salesforce. Coordinate a smooth handoff to onboarding and remain involved through implementation.

Maintain relationships after the close and identify expansion opportunities at the right time. Share market insights, competitive patterns, recurring objections, and blockers with the wider team. Represent MonetizeMore in the conversations and communities where the right publishers already operate.

What Success Looks Like You build a strong, credible pipeline and create access to publishers that fit our solutions. Your opportunities move forward with clear momentum because you understand the customer, establish urgency, and maintain structure throughout the sales process.

Publishers see you as a trusted commercial partner who understands their business, not simply as someone selling a product. Internally, your forecasts are reliable, your pipeline is clean, and your market insights help the wider team make better decisions. Video Introduction Please submit a short video covering: Who you are.

Your relevant experience. Why you believe you can succeed in this role. What you would bring to MonetizeMore ’s growth across EMEA and APAC. Benefits and Perks Work from anywhere in the world. Structure your schedule around performance and outcomes, not fixed hours. Competitive compensation aligned with your experience and impact.

High ownership over your territory, pipeline, and commercial results. The opportunity to work with major web and mobile app publishers across diverse global markets. Apply You do not need to check every box.

If you believe your experience, commercial instincts, relationships, or perspective can contribute to MonetizeMore ’s growth, we encourage you to apply. Show us how you think, what makes you stand out, and the value you can bring to the Revenue team. Originally posted on Himalayas

Build, foster and maintain relationships with consumer technology companies and device manufacturers to coordinate multi-level partnerships for the collection and recycling of lithium-ion battery materials. Align multiple locations and global stakeholders when necessary.

Understand each partner’s product lifecycle, sustainability commitments, and battery disposal needs to position Redwood as their preferred recycling partner.

Recognize customers’ product roadmaps and sustainability programs in detail, aligning our resources to the right programs and priorities, as well as identifying future growth opportunities in the consumer electronics battery sourcing space.

Evaluate deployment opportunities and lead the end-to-end launch process from partner qualification through go-live and ongoing account management.
Develop partnership models and partner-facing materials for Battery Bin deployments, including grant-funded, leased, sponsored, or paid service structures, as well as pitch decks, implementation guides, FAQs, and related collateral.
Track and report performance across consumer device partnerships and Battery Bin sites, using data to improve partner targeting, operational efficiency, cost-to-serve, and overall program economics.
Coordinate cross-functionally with engineering, operations, logistics, legal, policy, communications, and compliance teams to ensure partnerships and collection programs are compliant, high impact, and operationally sustainable.

Almost every large company in the DACH region is facing the same task: the transformation to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point — nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.
That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI layer for S/4HANA transformation: we read code, processes and documentation, make the existing landscape transparent, and deliver the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards — including in day-to-day operations, long after the system integrators have moved on.
We've raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. s.h: Meet the team behind this journey
s.t:
At DeepL, we're on an exciting adventure to expand our operations to match our ambitious growth plans. At the heart of this journey is our Sales team, a cornerstone of DeepL's market expansion and customer engagement strategy.
Our mission is clear: to build and develop high-performing sales teams that embody DeepL's innovative spirit and commitment to excellence. As a member of our Sales team, you will play a central role in growing our business and expanding our global reach into new markets. Working in close partnership with Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams, you will collaborate to deliver tailored solutions that genuinely meet our clients' needs.
About this opportunity
We are looking for an exceptional sales professional based in Austria (preferable) OR Switzerland to establish and grow DeepL's presence in the Austrian market. This is a rare opportunity to build something meaningful in a market where we're just getting started.

You will be a key player in our Austrian expansion, bringing together an entrepreneurial approach with deep market knowledge — and you won't be doing it alone. You'll have the full support of an experienced, collaborative international team behind you.

Shape our Austrian market entry: You will be at the forefront of DeepL's expansion into Austria, introducing our market-leading translation services to clients and helping them break down language barriers
Build with purpose: Establish our sales foundation in Austria — creating processes, relationships, and market presence where little currently exists
Become a trusted market expert: Develop deep knowledge of the Austrian business landscape, cultural nuances, and customer needs to position DeepL as a valued and trusted solution
Represent and advocate: Serve as an expert on DeepL's products and your customers' needs, troubleshooting thoughtfully and resolving inquiries with care
Own the full sales cycle: As a trusted partner to new and incoming customers, you will qualify and convert leads and guide opportunities from first contact to close
Set and reach meaningful goals: Work towards monthly activity, pipeline, and revenue goals as we establish our presence in the market together
Cultivate a strong pipeline: Identify and develop new business opportunities, including upselling and cross-selling where it adds real value for clients
Manage diverse opportunities: Respond to inbound prospects and customers, navigating a varied mix of opportunities from qualification through to close
Stay organised and forward-looking: Track opportunity and customer details including use cases, timelines, and next steps to keep things moving smoothly
Connect across teams: Work closely with our diverse, international, and welcoming teams — from SDRs to Marketing — collaborating across borders with openness and curiosity
Qualities we look for
We know that confidence gaps and imposter syndrome can sometimes hold people back from applying. If you're excited about this role and feel you have most of what we're looking for, we'd genuinely love to hear from you — even if you don't tick every box.
Entrepreneurial mindset: You enjoy building from the ground up and feel energised by the challenge of creating something new. You're comfortable with ambiguity and motivated by the opportunity to make a real impact
Deep Austrian market knowledge: You have genuine knowledge and appreciation of Austrian business culture, market dynamics, and customer preferences — and you understand what makes the market unique
Cultural fluency: You connect authentically with Austrian clients and partners, and bring a genuine appreciation for local values and business practices
Solid full-cycle sales experience: A proven track record in Enterprise Sales with the ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals
SaaS expertise: Experience in software sales — especially SaaS — is preferred
Strong communication skills: Excellent organisation, presentation, and communication skills (verbal and written) across multicultural contexts
Adaptability and resilience: You feel comfortable in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment and can shift priorities while maintaining momentum
Collaborative spirit: You thrive when working as part of a team, enjoy supporting colleagues, and value cross-functional collaboration
Language proficiency: Fluent in both, German and English

💬 Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS.
For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.
What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.
Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book , which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe , our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.
We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.

Most of our growth so far has happened in England. Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland are three separate health systems, each with its own clinical systems, procurement routes, information governance rules and digital strategy, and none of them have an ICB layer to sell into. This role owns all three.
It is a genuinely blank page. You work out what winning looks like in each nation, then build the repeatable way to do it, selling everything from a single practice subscription to a health board wide agreement.
Owning three health systems, not one region: building pipeline across Scottish and Welsh health boards, clusters, PCNs, GP federations and HSC Trusts in Northern Ireland, and adapting your approach to the structures that actually exist in each.
Selling at every level: running fast, high volume practice level deals alongside long, multi stakeholder board and national negotiations, and knowing which one you are in.
Winning the technical argument: these deals are frequently won or lost on integration. You will hold your own with eHealth teams, IG leads and national bodies on clinical systems, APIs, deployment routes and assurance, without waiting for an engineer to join the call.
Turning pilots into contracts: generating credible local evidence and then converting it into paid, scaled agreements rather than letting it stall as a permanent trial.
Using data to pick your battles: building the territory model from list sizes, usage, adoption and pipeline data, and using it to decide where a national deal is realistic and where practice by practice is the faster path.
Building the playbook: leaving behind documented, repeatable go to market approaches per nation, so this patch scales beyond you.
You should apply if...
You are a proven deal-closer with a track record of carrying your own number and consistently hitting it.
You are comfortable at both ends of the deal size range, equally credible on a quick practice level close and a twelve month, multi stakeholder board negotiation.
You are technically fluent and can pick up how a product integrates with the systems around it, explain it accurately to a technical audience, and stay credible when the questions get detailed.
You are not put off by complexity, whether that is clinical systems, interoperability, deployment routes or information governance. You treat it as part of the sale, not someone else’s problem.
You are a strategic thinker who can build a territory plan from a blank page, defend the choices in it, and change it when the ground shifts.
You are data-led and at home in spreadsheets, CRM and reporting tools, able to turn complex information into clear priorities and a compelling pitch.
You are a self-starter who is energised rather than unnerved by an unmapped patch and no established playbook.
You are mission-driven and motivated by the chance to change how healthcare communication works across three nations at once.
What’s in it for me?
You'll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we're led by our Principles and our mission to solve healthcare productivity.

We are searching for a driven hunter with a proven track record to lead Partly's expansion across the UK independent repairer market. This is an opportunity to positively disrupt an industry and pioneer the way independent repairers source and procure parts—bringing a fragmented, outdated process into the modern era.
You will own your territory end to end, taking repairers from cold to active on the Partly platform, fast. Reporting to the Repairer Commercial Lead, you will be the engine behind our UK growth—hunting, qualifying, demoing, and closing with the support of best-in-class sales technology.
You will be working closely with a passionate commercial team and backed by an exceptional group of people at Partly HQ, helping shape the playbook as you go—testing messaging, running high-volume outreach, and proving out a sales model built to scale.
Please note: This role involves travel to customer sites. Due to the locations, candidates must hold a valid UK driver's license.
(Collision/parts domain knowledge is preferred but not required—we value sharp thinkers who learn fast.)
💻 What will you do
Full-cycle sales: You own the process from prospecting to close. You will source leads, run discovery calls, demo the platform, and get contracts signed.
Own your territory: You will manage a specific UK region, building relationships with repairers and leveraging local supplier networks to get your foot in the door.
Translate tech to value: You will simplify the technical aspects of Partly. You won't just demo software; you will explain how it saves them hours a week and fixes their procurement headaches.
Consultative selling: You advise repairers on their procurement processes and handle tough questions and objections with confidence, using infrastructure-first messaging (repairer-owned platforms; your pricing, your relationships, your control).
High-velocity hunting: Execute a consistent volume of outbound activity (calls, emails, LinkedIn) to generate your own pipeline. You aren't afraid of the phone.
Work as a pod: Collaborate with RevOps (deal desk/dashboards) and Onboarding to ensure clean handoffs and time-to-live within target.
Pipeline discipline: Maintain rigorous hygiene and forecasting in CRM; communicate risks early; and keep a tight next-step cadence across 15–25 active opportunities.
Feedback loops: Feed insights back to Product, Engineering, and GTM (patterns in objections, integration needs, invoicing quirks) to improve win rates and time-to-launch.
Want to learn more about the problems we're solving and the culture we're building at Partly? Hear directly from our team here: https://shorturl.at/DPDdl
🥷 Your skills
SaaS DNA: 2–4+ years of experience as a top-performing SDR or AE in a B2B SaaS environment. You understand how software sales work.
Tech savvy: You know your way around a CRM (HubSpot preferred) and modern prospecting tools (Apollo, Surfe, etc.). You use data to work smarter, not just harder.
Resilient & proactive: You are prepared to get on the road or the phone. You can handle objections and turn them into conversations about value and ROI.
Process-driven: You can manage a high-velocity pipeline without dropping details, but you'll suggest improvements when you see them.
Credible communicator: Confident with senior operators; excellent emails/proposals; calm, direct objection handling (especially "Are you a marketplace?").
Technically curious: Able to learn repairer workflows and systems (BMS, invoicing, etc.) and translate them into practical implementation steps.
Growth mindset: You are eager to learn. You record your calls (Loom/Gong), listen to feedback, and actively try to get 1% better every day.
Ownership: Proactive, resourceful, and comfortable being accountable for outcomes.

About Alma
At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well-balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place: serving merchants and consumers.
Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty and deliver a seamless shopping experience, without encouraging bad debt.
As the buy now, pay later leader in France and an active player in 10 European countries, we have empowered more than 25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers.
With 380+ Almakers and €100M+ in ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we are just getting started!

This position is for a CDR based in Paris.
You will join Alma’s SMB Sales team, made up of more than 20 people, and more specifically our four-person Inbound team.
As the team continues to grow alongside Alma, you will have the opportunity to leverage your sales skills while continuing to learn, develop and receive support from experienced teammates. Your goal will be to become the best sales professional you can be, with the support of the wider Revenue organization.
You will also work alongside a European, multilingual and multi-country Revenue organization of more than 80 people, giving you the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues across markets and cultures.

Since Alma was founded in 2019, the Inbound team has been a key pillar of our commercial growth. As an Inbound Account Executive , you will play a central role in helping SMB merchants across France and Europe discover, adopt and grow with Alma.
Your mission will be to turn inbound opportunities into long-term commercial relationships, from the first conversation to the first transaction.
Own the inbound sales cycle: qualify, understand and convert leads from different sources, focusing on merchants with less than €5 million in annual revenue.
Build and manage your pipeline: organize your time, prioritize opportunities and manage every lead from qualification through to the first sale.
Deliver consistent performance: work towards monthly, quarterly and annual targets while maintaining a high level of execution and delivering an excellent customer experience.
Master the art of selling: continuously sharpen your discovery, sales, negotiation and closing techniques through practice, coaching and feedback.
Become a trusted expert: develop a deep understanding of the retail, e-commerce, finance and payments industries, both in France and across Europe.
Grow with Alma: contribute to the continued development of the Inbound team and help shape the way we support and convert the next generation of Alma merchants.
This role is ideal for someone ambitious, curious and eager to take ownership, grow quickly and make a tangible impact on Alma’s growth.
You will work with
As an Inbound Account Executive , you’ll work with a range of tools to manage your activity, improve your sales performance and better understand our merchants:
Salesforce: our CRM, where you’ll manage your leads, pipeline and sales activity.
Gong: to automate parts of your workflow, record your calls and review them to continuously improve your sales techniques.
Aircall: to manage your day-to-day calls with prospects and merchants.
Slack: to communicate directly with your colleagues and collaborate across teams.
Google Workspace: for the day-to-day productivity and collaboration tools used across the team.
Looker: to access and analyze business and sales data.
Additional retail and merchant intelligence tools: you’ll discover these over time, alongside the wider teams, to deepen your understanding of our market and prospects.

To succeed in this job
Humility: you learn from your mistakes, welcome feedback and continuously improve alongside the team.
Autonomy: you can quickly take ownership of your pipeline, manage your opportunities and convert merchants independently.
Curiosity: you’re eager to understand the retail, e-commerce, finance and payments ecosystems in which Alma operates, and become a recognized expert in these areas.
Rigor: you pay attention to every step of the sales cycle and maintain high standards to deliver sustainable performance and exceed your targets.
And it would be a plus if you also
Language skills: you are bilingual in English and either bilingual or a native speaker of Spanish or German .
Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience.
What’s in it for you
If you join us, you will have the opportunity to grow and make an impact through:
A true sales school: learn every day alongside experienced sales professionals and develop the skills, habits and mindset to build a successful career in one of France’s leading tech companies.
A high-performing, supportive team: join a close-knit and caring environment where people challenge, support and look after one another, with high standards and genuine attention to individual needs.
An ambitious and sustainable company: contribute to Alma’s ambition to scale across Europe profitably, within a stable and well-structured organization.
A career you can build: benefit from a clear and evolving career path, with the opportunity to grow, take on new responsibilities and thrive alongside Alma’s teams over the long term.
